objective_value: <float> Total cost of the purchasing tour, combining travel costs along traversed edges and purchase costs at visited markets.
visited_markets: <list[int]> Markets (excluding the depot) that the purchaser visits during the tour.
tour: <list[int]> Ordered sequence of vertices starting at the depot that describes the traversal order of the closed tour.
tour_edges: <list[list[int]]> Undirected edges traversed by the tour, each given as a pair of endpoint vertices.
purchases: <dict, key: '{product}' -> dict, key: '{market}'> Quantity of each product bought at each market along the tour.
